design: 24 synthetic scenarios x 2 prompt styles x 2 conditions; six batched generation sessions; same inherited model configuration, no model overrides
limitations: Baseline instructed not to load Your Voice; both conditions still inherit host/system writing guidance.
Cases generated in batches, not 96 independent cold sessions.
Two styles, one output per style/condition; no repeated stochastic samples for identical prompts.
No human grading or calibrated judges; no Claude comparison.
Long input distractors tested; twenty-turn conversation retention not tested.
